title: Page 8
content_zh:
他的额头瞬间冒出了好几条黑线，实在不懂女人的反应怎么可以前后差异这么大，他不顺着她要被打被骂，顺着她也要被打被骂，他到底该怎么做？

“我怎么那么笨，居然爱上你这个无情无义以为用钱就可以买到一切的臭家伙！”她的眼光真差！

赵霖一点都不介意被骂，他真正在意的是，她那句爱上他了，而这句话像跳针般一直在他的脑海中盘旋，他很确定，她说她爱上他了！

他一个情绪激动，一把将她给紧紧揽入怀里，叹息，再叹息，却没有任何解释。

白薇秀吓到眼泪停了。这是怎么一回事，他怎么突然抱住她了呢？

将手松开时，赵霖激动的道：“我以为只有我而已，没想到你也是。”

“我才不像你无情无……”白薇秀直觉回呛，但说到一半她傻住了。

不是，他不是这个意思，而是……

“你这个大坏蛋，如果你也是，干么还要送这种合约过来！”现在是砸合约也不能泄愤了，而是想直接捶他，在这当下，她才发觉骨子里有火爆因子。

“我舍不得你为我受委屈。”

“那现在呢？”之前不确定她是否爱他就舍不得她受委屈，那现在呢？她就不委屈了吗？

“现在只好委屈你了。”其实，发现自己心里有她，不就是因为这一次短暂的分离让他惊觉，要不早察觉了，怎舍得放她离开。

他是个很自私的人，行不了大爱，心理状况的确不太好，但他会非常非常认真的守护他们之间的爱情，一辈子都不会放弃。

人总是在失去之后才惊觉后悔，白薇秀又何尝不是，还好她跟赵霖还有补救的机会。

思及此，她的眼泪又扑簌簌的直落，但这一次不是因为伤心难过，而是开心。

但赵霖哪知这女人心的敏感，她一哭，他又慌了，一点都不像是个危机处理高手，更遑论他还是顾问公司的负责人呢！

还好他呆慌了一下后马上想到解决办法，他将哭得一塌糊涂的白薇秀深情的拥入怀里，吻上她的唇。

这下子，她再也哭不了了吧，这个方法真是太好了，他发出满足的叹息。

白薇秀跟许安安说要去一趟便利商店，结果人直接被赵霖带回家里，激烈的滚了一整晚的床单，叫到喉咙都哑了，直到早上全身酸痛的醒来，才惊觉忘记打电话跟许安安说一声。

天儿啊，都已经早上快十点了，果然纵欲是件非常不好的事。

看着身旁像个孩子般熟睡的赵霖，白薇秀赶紧拿起手机，转过身压低声音拨电话给许安安。

许安安嘲笑了白薇秀两声，但却一点都不担心，原来他早就猜到了，就她自以为掩饰得很好，真是尴尬。

挂掉电话后，回身看着熟睡的男人，不对，更正，是熟睡中的帅男人，他真的很帅，帅到连她都快要流口水了，而且这个男人，是她的。

拥有这样的帅老公，她算是赚到了吗？可是她想了想，又觉得自己好像赔本了，她最爱计较，这档子总要算得清楚，于是她伸出食指，戳了戳他的脸颊。

“我觉得亏了呢，这恋爱也不算谈，追求更是没有，直接成为你的老婆，太不划算了。”

本来她也只是说说而已，想着他睡着了听不到，却没料到他只是装睡，忽地睁开眼睛瞅着她，认真的问道：“敢情是要补偿来着？”

白薇秀推了他一把，娇嗔道：“坏蛋，装睡。”心里话都被他给听去了。

他将她一把抱住，点点她的俏鼻。“快说，你希望我怎么补偿你？”

她黑白分明的眼眸转啊转，开始开条件，“首先，你每天要说五次，不，十次我爱你。”

“简单，我爱你、我爱你、我爱你……”赵霖一口气就说了十次。

白薇秀白了他一眼。“不是这样说，而是要挑最适当的时机说，分次说的。”

“好，我爱你。”说完，他轻啄了一下她的红唇。

她满意的笑了，接着又道：“第二，我们一个礼拜至少要约会两次。”

“每天约会都行。”赵霖马上加码。

他们都那么忙，怎么可能每天约会，她笑他不切实际，两次就行了。

他又再一次体会女人心的难以捉摸，明明刚才还在抱怨她亏本，他想要她捞回本她还不要，奇怪了。

“第三，你每个礼拜要送我一束花。”

赵霖马上点头，以上三点都很简单。

“至于第四嘛……”白薇秀想了又想，表情看起来却是一脸困窘。

没关系，她想不出来，他替她想好了。“第四，我每天晚上都要把你伺候得舒舒服服的，让你“性”福又美“满”。”

他的双关语让白薇秀一张小脸瞬间爆红，娇瞪了他一眼。“你还真不害臊，这种话也说得出口。”

“为什么不能说？你昨晚不也说了很多，什么“再快一点”、“我好舒服”、“我还想”……唔唔唔。”

她用力捂住他的嘴。“你还说！”

“好、好，我不说，不说总行了。”可赵霖的眼神还是坏坏的，在裹着丝被仍看得出来身材性感的白薇秀身上转了一圈。“我不说，换你来说。”说完，他像头恶狼扑向她，将她压制在身下。

“不行，上班要迟到了！”白薇秀发出抗议。

第10章(2)

白薇秀跟赵霖将心里头的爱意开诚布公之后，成了名符其实的夫妻，他很认真将她的抗议记在心里，并非常努力的实践，两个人每天甜蜜蜜又黏踢踢，看得许安安跟“一生一世”的员工们都闪到不行。

有一次许安安实在受不了，故意在白薇秀面前大声抱怨，“现在都得戴墨镜上班，免得瞎了眼。”

白薇秀一个礼拜至少收到两束附带情书的花，而她总是一边看着情书一边傻笑，周身散发着粉红色的甜蜜氛围。

“都已经结婚了，有必要这样吗？”他许安安承认自己就是嫉妒没错，哼。

还有好友脖子上若隐若现的激情草莓，只有增加没有减少，这是在告诉别人，他们每晚都火辣辣吗？真的有够碍眼！不过看在好友这么幸福的分上，许安安其实心里也很开心。

至于当初签订的合约，赵霖已经当着白薇秀的面撕毁。

她坐在他的大腿上，双手圈在他后颈，佯装不依的耍赖道：“这样要是你以后对我不好，我那两千万都拿不到了。”

“可是你拥有我了，你老公的身价可是高于两千万。”

“好吧。”白薇秀故作为难的回道：“那我就只好勉强接受你了。”

赵霖挑高一边的眉。“亲爱的，你很勉强？”

“是……有点啦，你也知道我爱钱啊，还是现金卡实在。”哼，她就是故意要报复，谁教他之前总说她爱钱，以为她为了钱，面子啊、自尊什么的都可以不要。

“你真是小心眼。”他宠溺的捏了捏她的俏鼻。

“你现在后悔还来得及。”她嘴巴是这么说，但双眼微眯，眸光带着浓浓的威胁意味，大有他只要说错一个字，她绝对会让他吃不完兜着走的态势。

“不后悔，也不敢后悔。”

“算你识相！”

突地，赵霖想起一件事必须跟她说清楚，关于白天吴德亮打电话给他告知的讯息。“老婆，颜芳菲的死，即将真相大白。”

白薇秀一惊。“难道她真的是被……”太可怕了，她不敢相信。

“不，她是真的死于意外，但她之所以会失足，是因为有人在她的饮料里下了药。”
content_en:
Several black lines suddenly appeared on his forehead. He really didn't understand how a woman's reaction could be so different. If he didn't follow her, he would be beaten and scolded, and if he followed her, he would be beaten and scolded. What should he do?

"How could I be so stupid that I fell in love with you, a ruthless and ruthless guy who thinks you can buy everything with money!" Her taste was really bad!

Zhao Lin didn't mind being scolded at all. What he really cared about was that she said she was in love with him, and this sentence kept swirling in his mind like a jumping needle. He was very sure that she said she was in love with him!

He was so excited that he held her tightly in his arms, sighing, and sighing again, but without any explanation.

Bai Weixiu was so scared that her tears stopped.What was going on? Why did he suddenly hug her?

When he let go of his hand, Zhao Lin said excitedly: "I thought it was just me, but I didn't expect you too."

"I'm not as ruthless as you..." Bai Weixiu responded instinctively, but she was stunned mid-sentence.

No, that's not what he meant, but...

"You're such a bad guy, if you are the same, why would you send me this kind of contract!" Now she couldn't vent her anger even if she broke the contract, but wanted to hit him directly. At this moment, she realized that there was a hot factor in her bones.

"I can't bear to have you suffer for me."

"What about now?" Before, he wasn't sure whether she loved him and he couldn't bear to let her suffer. But what about now?Isn't she aggrieved?

"Now I have no choice but to wrong you." In fact, when he realized that he had her in his heart, it was not because he was shocked by this brief separation. If he hadn't noticed it earlier, he wouldn't have been willing to let her go.

He is a very selfish person, unable to practice great love, and his mental condition is indeed not very good, but he will protect the love between them very, very seriously and will never give up in his life.

People always regret after losing something, and Bai Weixiu is no different. Fortunately, she and Zhao Lin still have a chance to make amends.

Thinking of this, her tears fell again, but this time it was not because of sadness, but because of happiness.

But Zhao Lin didn't know how sensitive this woman's heart was. When she cried, he panicked again. He didn't look like a crisis management expert at all, let alone the person in charge of a consulting company!

Fortunately, he panicked for a moment and immediately thought of a solution. He hugged the crying Bai Weixiu lovingly into his arms and kissed her on the lips.

Now, she couldn't cry anymore. This method was so good. He sighed with satisfaction.

Bai Weixiu told Xu An'an that she was going to a convenience store, but Zhao Lin took her home directly. She rolled on the bed sheets fiercely all night and screamed until her throat became hoarse. It wasn't until she woke up with soreness all over her body in the morning that she realized she had forgotten to call Xu An'an.

Oh my God, it's already almost ten o'clock in the morning. As expected, indulgence is a very bad thing.

Looking at Zhao Lin who was sleeping like a child next to her, Bai Weixiu quickly picked up her phone, turned around and dialed Xu Anan in a low voice.

Xu Anan laughed at Bai Weixiu twice, but she was not worried at all. It turned out that he had already guessed it, and she thought she had concealed it well. It was really embarrassing.

After hanging up the phone, she turned around and looked at the sleeping man. No, correction, it was a sleeping handsome man. He was really handsome, so handsome that she was almost drooling, and this man was hers.

Has she earned it by having such a handsome husband?But after thinking about it, she felt that she had lost money. She loved to be careless, and she always had to figure it out clearly, so she stretched out her index finger and poked his cheek.

"I think it's a loss. This is not a relationship, and there is no pursuit. It's not cost-effective to directly become your wife."

Originally, she was just talking, thinking that he would not be able to hear because he was asleep, but she didn't expect that he was just pretending to be asleep. She suddenly opened her eyes, looked at her, and asked seriously: "Do you want compensation for your love?"

Bai Weixiu pushed him and said coquettishly: "Bad guy, pretend to be asleep." He heard everything in her heart.

He hugged her and tapped her pretty nose."Tell me, how do you want me to compensate you?"

Her black and white eyes turned and she began to make conditions, "First of all, you have to say I love you five times, no, ten times a day."

"Simple, I love you, I love you, I love you..." Zhao Lin said it ten times in one breath.

Bai Weixiu rolled her eyes at him."I don't mean to say it this way, but I have to choose the most appropriate time to say it and say it in stages."

"Okay, I love you." After saying that, he pecked her red lips.

She smiled with satisfaction, and then added: "Second, we have to date at least twice a week."

"Every day is fine." Zhao Lin immediately increased the pressure.

They were both so busy, how could they date every day? She laughed at him for being unrealistic, just twice would be enough.

He once again experienced the elusiveness of a woman's heart. He was clearly complaining that she was losing money just now, but he wanted her to get her money back and she still didn't want it. It was strange.

"Third, you have to give me a bouquet of flowers every week."

Zhao Lin nodded immediately. The above three points were very simple.

"As for the fourth one..." Bai Weixiu thought about it again and again, but her expression looked embarrassed.

It doesn't matter, she can't think of it, he figured it out for her."Fourth, I will serve you comfortably every night so that you can be "sexually" happy and happy."

His pun made Bai Weixiu's face instantly turn red, and she gave him a cute look."You are really not ashamed to say such things."

"Why can't you say it? Didn't you say a lot last night, such as "Faster", "I feel so comfortable", "I still want to"... Uh-huh."

She covered his mouth hard."You still said that!"

"Okay, okay, I won't tell you, let alone the head office." But Zhao Lin's eyes were still evil, and he turned around Bai Weixiu, who still had a sexy figure wrapped in a silk quilt."I won't tell you, let you tell me." After saying that, he pounced on her like a vicious wolf and pinned her down.

"No, I'm going to be late for work!" Bai Weixiu protested.

Chapter 10(2)

After Bai Weixiu and Zhao Lin confessed their love, they became a real couple. He took her protest seriously and practiced it very hard. The two of them were sweet and sticky every day, which made Xu Anan and the employees of "One Life" feel dizzy.

One time Xu Anan couldn't stand it anymore and deliberately complained loudly in front of Bai Weixiu, "Now I have to wear sunglasses to work to avoid going blind."

Bai Weixiu receives at least two bouquets of flowers with love letters a week, and she always smiles while reading the love letters, exuding a sweet pink atmosphere.

"We are already married, is this necessary?" He Xu Anan admitted that he was just jealous, huh.

There is also the looming passion strawberry on my friend's neck, which only increases but does not decrease. Is this telling others that they are hot every night?It’s really an eyesore!But seeing how happy his friend was, Xu Anan was actually very happy.

As for the originally signed contract, Zhao Lin had already torn it up in front of Bai Weixiu.

She sat on his lap, put her hands around his neck, and pretended to be indifferent: "If you treat me badly in the future, I won't be able to get the 20 million."

"But you own me, and your husband is worth more than 20 million."

"Okay." Bai Weixiu replied reluctantly, "Then I will have to accept you reluctantly."

Zhao Lin raised an eyebrow."Honey, are you being reluctant?"

"Yeah...a little bit. You know I love money, and the cash card is really good." Humph, she just wanted revenge on purpose. Who taught him that she always said she loved money before, thinking that she could give up face, self-esteem, etc. for money.

"You are so petty." He pinched her pretty nose lovingly.

"It's too late for you to regret it now." She said this, but her eyes were slightly narrowed with a strong hint of threat. If he said one wrong word, she would definitely make him walk away without finishing the meal.

"I don't regret it, and I don't dare to regret it."

"You know what's going on!"

Suddenly, Zhao Lin remembered something that he had to tell her clearly, about the news that Wu Deliang called him during the day."Honey, the truth about Yan Fangfei's death will soon be revealed."

Bai Weixiu was surprised."Could she really be..." It was too scary, she couldn't believe it.

"No, she did die in an accident, but the reason why she slipped was because someone spiked her drink."
